description: Land Acquisition - Yakalla, Waguruwela and Bolagama, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Yakalla, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring specific parcels of land needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content is exclusively about land matters (acquisition for public purpose) and fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
